explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/17: are there infinitely many primes p such that every even n ≤ p − 3 is a difference q_1 − q_2 of primes q_1, q_2 ≤ p? `IsClusterPrime` encodes this with the comparison and difference taken in ℤ, which avoids truncation problems at small p. The test in the file confirms 97 as the first non-cluster prime, matching the page. Faithful.
